description: This file contains test cases for the FastAPI project template in a code generation framework. It includes fixtures for setting up temporary directories and mock templates, and tests for project initialization, template info retrieval, post-processing script execution, configuration loading, and variable replacement within templates.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a mock template directory with configuration and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample ProjectConfig instance for testing.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests initializing a project with the FastAPI template and verifies output files and content.

methods.name: test_fastapi_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that the template's initial info, including commands, are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests execution of a post-processing script that creates a marker file to confirm execution.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Loads project configuration from a JSON file and verifies correct parsing.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures template variables in files are correctly replaced with project configuration values.
